steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Non-verbal communication (NVC) conveys meaning without words: body language (posture, gestures), facial expressions (emotions), eye contact (interest, honesty), proxemics (use of personal space), and paralinguistics (tone, pitch, speed of voice). | Key Fact: Facial expressions: Ekman found six basic emotions expressed universally across cultures - happiness, sadness, anger, fear, surprise, disgust. This suggests facial expressions are innate (supporting nature). However, display rules (cultural rules about when to show emotions) affect how freely people express them. | Key Fact: Eye contact: signals interest and attention.
